items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like when Trane came in, Trane wiped out everybody, because everybody said, “I’ve got to play like Coltrane.”

ctx.x: What about the regional stuff? Did you hear a big difference between like – at that time, it seemed to be more of a bigger difference when bands came from different regions, like a band that came from Kansas City area. It was a huge . . .

Oh yeah, of course. Well, they lost that with the advent of records, everybody listening to the same records. Like when Trane came in, Trane wiped out everybody, because everybody said, “I’ve got to play like Coltrane.” Everybody said, “But man, you’re not going anywhere being a Coltrane clone.” “I don’t care. I got to play this.” So consequently now, how many Tranes is it?
